paper: MemoryWAM: Efficient World Action Modeling with Persistent Memory

argument_reconstruction.problem: bounded-window WAMs forget; full-history WAMs scale poorly
argument_reconstruction.mechanism: two full-token initial frames + four full-token recent frames + eight persistent gist tokens per historical frame
evidence_chain: Eqs. 5-6 establish O(N) to O(N/d) sequence-dependent cost and d=15
Tables 1-3 cover benchmark, real-world, and ablation evidence
boundaries: 15x applies to long-term video KV component, not whole system
efficiency evidence is inference-focused; training cost is unreported
cross-model RMBench results are not equal-backbone controls
